🧠 Helios Memory

Lessons learned and critical rules

🚨 Never Set Perplexity as Primary Model

Feb 10, 2026

What happened: Tried to set Perplexity API as primary model — gateway crashed, lost all keys and config.

Why it broke: Perplexity is for web search, not general-purpose AI. Lacks full tool suite.

Rule: Perplexity is a tool, not a brain. Configure as subagent only.

⚙️ Config Safety

Before Editing Config

  1. Backup the current config
  2. Make incremental changes
  3. Test one change at a time
  4. Never replace entire "agents" block at once

Recovery Steps

  1. Read SOUL.md and USER.md to recover context
  2. Rebuild config from known-good state
  3. Restart gateway: openclaw gateway restart
  4. Verify tools work before continuing
